findings.observed: bootstrap filters only exact native option names after split(=). run_native_capture uses default argparse allow_abbrev=True. Native --stag=OTHER_PATH is an unambiguous abbreviation of --stage and appears after injected --stage, overriding destination. Native --chil is accepted child abbreviation and can skip host creation before failing host-marker validation.
findings.basis: Static argparse default behavior inference; no parser or capture execution performed.
findings.minimal_proposal: Validate native options against actual accepted full spelling only or reject all prefixes of protected native options; do not merely extend one exact blacklist.

findings.documented_claim: Forced fresh external stage and no caller stage override
findings.observed: Only native segment is checked. capture_host_mode and driver construct capture_refresh argv with --stage neutral first and caller capture args later. Capture-side --stage OTHER_PATH or --stag OTHER_PATH overrides args.stage; capture_refresh.main then resolves that supplied destination. Host runtime receipt stage and recorder destination can diverge.

findings.minimal_proposal: Reject stage option and argparse-compatible abbreviations on capture side; preserve legitimate capture flags. Recheck final interface after any fix.

findings.observed: 12G cap is enforced by run_capped systemd scope but no RAM scheduler lease is acquired in these files. README explicitly requires appropriate separate RAM lease.
findings.classification: Documented limitation, not an undocumented promised guarantee.
